doc.name: Analytics Legends — SAP Analytics intelligence (read-only)
doc.description: Read-only data on the SAP AI & analytics services market (Joule, Datasphere, Business Data Cloud, SAC, BW/4HANA, Databricks): firms, postings, day rates, news, concepts, studies, Academy. Reached over MCP (JSON-RPC, streamable HTTP) — this service does not implement A2A message/send.

skills.name: Find the answer to an SAP AI & analytics problem
skills.description: Start here for an SAP AI & analytics PROBLEM, asked in EN, FR or DE (agents in production, Joule value, BW 7.5 cliff, BDC vs Datasphere vs Databricks…). Returns up to 3 tracked challenges: short answer, what shipped, what is announced, next steps, citation_url. Empty = not a tracked challenge; try search_concepts. Public.

skills.name: Search the SAP AI & analytics firm directory
skills.description: Search SAP AI & analytics service providers (consultancies, Big-4, agencies, SAP partners, platforms). Returns slug, name, HQ, website, claim, sap_signal_band; SAP end-customers are in find_sap_clients. Public.

skills.name: Count the firm directory by country, region, kind, module or SAP signal
skills.description: Count the firm directory by country, region, kind, module or sap_signal_band, with search_firms' filters, instead of paging search_firms to tally. Rows: value, n; the tail folds into '(other)'. Public.

skills.name: Get one firm's published profile
skills.description: One firm's public profile by its slug from search_firms (verbatim; some slugs are numeric). A brand name such as 'accenture' returns the list of its entities to choose from. Public.

skills.name: List firm kinds with live counts
skills.description: The organisation kinds of the firm directory with a live count each — the vocabulary of search_firms' `kind`. Public, complete without a key.

skills.name: List the CV/profile platforms a consultant can sign up on
skills.description: Platforms where an SAP consultant can create a profile (freelance marketplaces, job boards, expert networks), with signup URL, confidence grade and assessment date. Public, complete without a key.

skills.name: Search the public SAP AI & analytics contract radar
skills.description: Search public SAP AI & analytics postings. Mostly PERMANENT roles: set employment_type for freelance questions. A posting listed in several cities is one row with `locations`. Public, except the link to the original listing (paid).

skills.name: Search SAP AI & analytics market news
skills.description: Search the curated SAP AI & analytics news corpus; defaults to SAP-specific items (scope 'sap'). Each item carries source_url (the publisher) and citation_url: cite both. Public.

skills.name: Search the SAP AI & analytics concept encyclopaedia
skills.description: Search the SAP AI & analytics concept encyclopaedia (the stack's vocabulary): slug, title, category, level, editor's summary. Full card: get_concept_card (paid). Public.

skills.name: Concept metadata and editor's summary
skills.description: One concept's metadata and editor's summary by slug from search_concepts (e.g. 'sap-business-data-cloud-bdc'). The card body, cheat sheet and tables are paid (get_concept_card). Public.

skills.name: List the deep-research studies (metadata only)
skills.description: List the deep-research studies: title, edition, as-of date, audience, word count, citation_url, one row per study in the language asked. Metadata only; the text is get_study (paid). Public.

skills.name: Public SAP AI & analytics day-rate aggregate
skills.description: Published SAP freelance day-rate aggregate by country, specialisation and seniority: min/max (median, p10, p90 when sourced) in the row's currency, with source, date and confidence. Small, secondary sources; 0 rows = no such cell here, see `_meta.available_*`. Public.

skills.name: SAP AI & analytics module taxonomy
skills.description: The SAP module/product taxonomy (codes such as DATASPHERE, BDC, SAC, BW4HANA with labels) that other tools filter on; use it to map loose wording to a code. Public, complete without a key.

skills.name: Search the Academy training catalogue
skills.description: Search the Academy training catalogue (Datasphere, BDC, SAC, BW/4HANA, Databricks) by text, track or level. Rows are in the language asked. Full text: get_academy_module (paid). Public.

skills.name: Traverse the learning knowledge graph
skills.description: Relations between concepts, Academy modules, studies and vendors: list nodes (node_type, query) or one node's edges (node_id). The only tool that serves edges. Public.

skills.name: Full concept card
skills.description: The full concept card: body, cheat sheet, glossary, pro tip and the four analysis tables, EN/FR/DE. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

skills.name: Read a study
skills.description: Read a study's text: without `section` returns the section list and introduction, then pass a heading as `section`. Slugs from list_studies. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

skills.name: Read an Academy module
skills.description: Read one Academy module in full (body, objectives, summary) by id or slug from find_academy_modules; `lang` picks one language. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

skills.name: Search the SAP end-customer corpus
skills.description: Search the SAP END-CUSTOMER corpus (companies that run SAP); each row says its verification status. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

skills.name: One SAP end-customer profile
skills.description: One SAP end-customer's full profile (products in use, modules, analytics solutions, evidence) by id from find_sap_clients. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

skills.name: Expansion brief for a target region
skills.description: Brief for entering a region: providers there (local vs group), SAP end-customer counts by country and industry, live opportunities, brand families present in both regions. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

skills.name: Local partner or acquisition candidates for a market entry
skills.description: Rank local service providers of a country or region as partner or acquisition candidates; local_only (default) excludes foreign groups' subsidiaries. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

skills.name: Firm intelligence profile
skills.description: Intelligence profile of a services firm: SAP practice size, partner level, products delivered, typical day rate, notable clients. Search by name, country, product or engagement mode; a null is a data gap. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

skills.name: Submit a private SAP need
skills.description: ACTION: deposit an SAP need as a private brief, matched every 6 h against consenting consultants; nothing is e-mailed. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

skills.name: Brief selection and introductions
skills.description: ACTION: a brief's anonymised selection, or with candidate_ref an introduction request the consultant answers in the app. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

bearer.description: Optional: a personal API key (alk_…) opens the paid tools; the public tranche answers without it.
